title: Foot in the Mouth
desc: You finally did it, one whole foot, straight into your mouth and the pride on your face said everything. A little sunshine and fewer layers were all you needed.
story: You had been working on this for days, straining and reaching, but the warm clothes and socks kept getting in the way. It was a little sunny, so we left you with less on and within no time your leg was up and your foot was in your mouth like you had been doing it your whole life. Mum and Dad were sitting right beside you and we both burst out laughing, because the determination that had been building for days finally had its moment. From that day on it became your absolute favourite thing, and now you are already eyeing up the second foot, because of course you are.
